title: TrueNAS Case & Fans (Jonsbo N4, isometric)

panels.title: Fan speed
panels.description: Measured RPM. Automatic = BIOS curve; override and smart modes appear as flat steps.

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: CPU (Tctl), GPU, NVMe, memory and the hottest drive.

panels.title: Power
panels.description: CPU package (RAPL) and GPU (i915 energy counter), live rates.

panels.title: Smart mode: temperature vs target
panels.description: Smoothed temperature the controller acts on, against its target (only while smart mode is on).

panels.title: Arc GPU engines
panels.description: intel_gpu_top engine utilisation via the intel-gpu-exporter.

panels.title: Fan control state
panels.description: Mode per fan: 2 = automatic (BIOS), 1 = override or smart, 0 = full speed. Guard: 1 = tripped.

panels.title: CPU usage (node-exporter)
panels.description: Busy and I/O-wait share of all CPU threads.

panels.title: Network (node-exporter)
panels.description: Receive and transmit per physical interface (virtual, bridge and docker interfaces hidden).

panels.title: Disk throughput (node-exporter)
panels.description: Read and write per physical disk (partitions, loop and zram devices hidden).
